verdict.rationale: Godot has extensive first-party GDScript and C# documentation, and a community member says it 'generally has good documentation'. Community notes also indicate GDScript has far more public examples than C#, and a built-in GDScript LSP gives agent tooling something to validate against. However, nothing in the pack directly shows LLM-generated Godot code working on the first try, and signals on API stability and doc quality are mixed: an older comment calls the scripting language poorly documented, the Godot 3.x LTS vs 4.x split points to multiple API generations in circulation, and the docs serve no llms.txt or markdown mirrors. Missing for 10: direct evidence of LLM first-try success, evidence of API stability across versions, evidence of abundant examples (especially for C#), and LLM-oriented doc formats.
